fact: The events occur on the fifteenth day of the party's voyage.
source_quote: On the fifteenth day of their voyage
subject: session date

fact: The party travels through a narrow, eerie tunnel illuminated by a purple glow.
source_quote: narrow, eerie tunnel illuminated by a purple glow
subject: darklake tunnel

fact: Blind cavefish drift mindlessly near the surface and bump against the hull of the boat.
source_quote: Blind cavefish drifted mindlessly near the surface, occasionally bumping against the hull of the boat
subject: blind cavefish

fact: The tunnel forks around a diamond-shaped limestone islet that is forty feet wide.
source_quote: tunnel forked around a diamond-shaped limestone islet, forty feet wide
subject: limestone islet

fact: The bone pyramid is eight feet high and five feet wide at its base.
source_quote: It was a pyramid of bones, eight feet high and five feet wide at its base
subject: bone pyramid

fact: The bone pyramid is crowned with a great horned ram skull positioned to stare at the travelers.
source_quote: crowned with a great horned ram skull that had been carefully positioned so its empty sockets stared directly at them
subject: horned ram skull

fact: Brannum Redmarch panics upon seeing the bone pyramid.
source_quote: Brannum Redmarch took one look at it and panicked
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Brannum Redmarch admits that he thought the party was going the other way.
source_quote: I thought we were going the other way
subject: brannum admission

fact: A violent beam of lightning erupts from behind a stalactite and strikes the boat.
source_quote: a violent beam of lightning erupted from behind a stalactite above the islet and tried to put a hole in their boat
subject: lightning attack

fact: The party fails the group check to avoid all harm, resulting in some damage to the boat.
source_quote: Not enough of them succeeded to avoid all harm, but their quick reflexes kept the boat seaworthy with only some damage
subject: boat check

fact: Thorin starts rowing the boat away from the islet.
subject: Thorin

fact: A ten-foot floating sphere of rotting flesh and dead eyes rises from behind a stalactite.
source_quote: rising from behind the great stalactite, a ten-foot floating sphere of rotting flesh and dead eyes drifted toward them
subject: beholder zombie

fact: The beholder zombie is an undead horror that understands nothing the party says.
source_quote: realize with a sinking feeling that the undead horror understood nothing he said
subject: beholder zombie

fact: Gyrgum casts Command on the beholder zombie.
source_quote: Gyrgum cast Command and ordered the creature to flee
subject: command spell

fact: The Command spell fails because the beholder zombie does not understand Gyrgum.
source_quote: ordered the creature to flee, only to realize with a sinking feeling that the undead horror understood nothing he said
subject: command failure

fact: It is unclear whether the lightning came from the beholder zombie or a second source.
source_quote: It is unclear whether the lightning came from the zombie or from a second source
subject: lightning source
